decoder_compatibility_limit: One earlier 749-AU 1080p capture decoded to 738 frames with OpenH264 and 749 with installed libavcodec. The failed OpenH264 check is retained. Client compatibility remains unresolved; no device frame-loss diagnosis follows from that count difference.
count_limit: The new pair each supplied 750 source buffers and 749 parsed AUs; all 749 AUs decoded. The boundary difference remains unexplained. Probe pass means a bounded data path and simultaneous start, not loss-free acceptance.
finding: Second 1080p25 stream fails with STREAMON errno 28 on either observed shared controller. Moving one camera to fc880000 while leaving the main Hub on fc000000 permits two simultaneous 1080p25 streams for about 30 seconds. Remaining four cameras still share the Type-C USB2 branch; five-camera acceptance remains false.
